run_get_data: run get_data to load a JSON file of DFT and force field interaction energy data split by CO2 and H2O
run_get_Fig4a: run get_Fig4a to generate a histogram of raw error distributions for CO2 and H2O force field predictions
run_get_Fig4b: run get_Fig4b to generate a binned average error bar plot with KDE density curves for CO2 and H2O
run_get_Fig4c: run get_Fig4c to generate a density-weighted scatter plot of CO2 DFT interaction energy versus absolute error
run_phys_err: run phys_err to calculate the mean absolute error for physisorption data points between DFT and force field predictions
